verification.summary: Both must-fix items from the last verdict are properly fixed, but the script never checks the Mock GitHub terminal's own comment-count display, only the GET /issues API — so the one feature accs.md explicitly asks to watch (the terminal logging a comment count) goes untested.

mustFix.problem: accs.md's step 'Check if the first issue logs that it has one comment' and the contract's 'Issues #<id>: (<commentCount>)' line both point at the terminal's rendered comment count, not the one-shot '[comment] +1' log line. The script never greps MOCK_LOG for 'Issues #$FIRST_ID: (1)' after the mutation (or for the (2)/(1)/(0) split after the tracker run), so a build that logs the mutation event but never updates or mis-renders the per-issue count on repaint would still pass.

shouldKnow.problem: Cap is set well above the mock dataset size (per the enriched spec's own assumption), so the truncation/'...' path in check_snapshots is exercised by logic only, never actually triggered by real output in this run.
